rundown: Phoenix beat Breakers 101-96. Phoenix came back: they were down 55-44 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Phoenix won it 30-19.
Leading the way — Phoenix: Nathan Sobey 30 pts, 9 ast; Yannis Morin 10 reb. Breakers: Skylar Mays 20 pts, 8 ast; Sam Mennenga 9 reb.
Where Phoenix won it: they won the boards 39-37, had 21 assists to 16 and turned it over 10 times to 12.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 18, 1:28 AM ET. It had Phoenix 43% and Breakers 57%, projecting Phoenix 100.5 – Breakers 102.5 (203 total, Breakers by 2).

Final: Phoenix 101 – Breakers 96. Wrong winner: it had Breakers at 57%, and Phoenix (43%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Phoenix came in with a 3% above average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (4-9, 97.9 scored and 98.1 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 100.5, they scored 101 (+0.5 points, 0% over); projected to allow 102.5, they allowed 96 (−6.5 points, 6% under).

Breakers came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (5-9, 90.6 scored and 91.4 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 102.5, they scored 96 (−6.5 points, 6% under); projected to allow 100.5, they allowed 101 (+0.5 points, 0% over).

The bigger miss was Breakers' scoring (-6.5 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 197 against 203 projected (-6), about the 35th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Phoenix by 5 against Breakers by 2 projected, about the 28th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.984 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -8.2 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 74 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.014 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Phoenix attack ×1.004, defense ×1.017 (4 games); Breakers attack ×1.001, defense ×1.008 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
